project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend

components.description: Account information and payment initiation services against the national PSD2 hub, including strong customer authentication (SCA) and consent lifecycle management.

components.name: Double-entry ledger service
components.description: Immutable double-entry accounting ledger with idempotent transaction posting, balance snapshots and daily reconciliation jobs.

components.name: Lender-borrower matching

components.name: KYC identity verification
components.description: Know-your-customer onboarding with document OCR, liveness check integration and sanctions-list screening.

components.name: Fraud signal detection
components.description: Heuristic fraud flagging over claim metadata (duplicate photos, velocity checks, geolocation mismatch) surfaced to human reviewers.

components.name: FX exposure reporting
components.description: Foreign-exchange exposure reports with configurable hedging thresholds and CSV export for the finance team.

components.name: Product recommendations

components.name: Promotions and coupons

components.description: Wishlist with cross-device sync and deep-linkable shareable looks.

components.name: Bulk order management
